name: Wakanoi Shuzo
about: Wakanoi Shuzo is a sake brewery in Iitoyo, in the Okitama district of Yamagata. It was founded in 1890. The brewery tells of a well dug downstream of the Noga River near the Wakamiya Hachimangu shrine that struck spring water good for brewing, and the company and brand names come from that water.

The brewing water is Noga River water filtered through granite, with a hardness of 22, which the brewery calls very soft. Some sake is aged in a snow room at the foot of Mt. Iide, held at 0 to 3 degrees C. Its lineup includes Hanamaru junmai ginjo and Ebisu Kotobuki.
sources: label of Wakanoi Hanamaru Junmai Ginjo Yukimuro (back label)
